text: Wow! Look at these machines!\nThey must be creating holy gems here.\nI gotta go negotiate with them!
Pelulu came back.\nShe has a holy gem in her hands but...
Pelulu tossed the gem into her mouth!
*munch munch* Sweet. It's so sweet.\nWhat happened you asked? As you can see,\nIt's not a holy gem. It's just a candy.
They say it's a specialty here and the machines\naround here are used only to make candies...
Dammit!! Do they really need such big machines\njust to make stupid candies?!
...Huh? Naiata? I asked about her but...\nEveryone said [I don't know.]
Well, they seemed to actually know her, though.\nIt's no use staying here, so let's get moving,\nshall we?
The body is glittering and giving off sweet\nsmell everytime it moves.
It looks like a golem made of candies...
Who are you? Don't disturb me.\nI'm collecting candies now.\nAlmost done collecting candies here.
Why am I collecting candies?\nI have no idea. I'm just obeying the voice that\nI hear from my body.
I guess it will tell me what to do next after\ncollecting the candies... So, I've never thought\nabout what to do after collecting the candies...
I told you the situation. Get out of my way.\n...You're so foolish.\nStop me by force if you want me to stop!
Oh... The magic is being broken...\nM-My body is scattering...\nWhat a... pity...
Now all that remains is to collect\nLefina's candies, but...
There aren't even any normal candies,\nlet alone Lefina’s special candies.\nMaybe they were absorbed by Candela?
